classification.difficultyReason: Interpret two journeys from a common distance reference, derive Keith's travelled distances from decreasing readings, convert minutes to hours and exclude his stop when calculating travelling average speed.

content.prompt: Jonathon lives in Wholetown and Keith lives in Halftown. Wholetown is 100 km from Halftown. Jonathon leaves Wholetown at 1 p.m. and Keith leaves Halftown at the same time. They use the same road. The graphs show the journeys of Jonathon and Keith.

spec.sourceRegion: Question 3 graph below the shared stem
spec.description: Common distance–time axes with dashed 10-unit grid; heavier guides at 30 and 90 minutes and 50 and 100 km. Keith is blue and Jonathon black.
spec.answerVisibility: All source graph information is permanently visible; no answer annotations.

children.label: a
children.prompt: How far is Jonathon from Wholetown at 1:40 p.m.?

answer.worked: 1:40 p.m. is 40 minutes after departure. At 40 minutes, Jonathon’s graph reads 40 km from Wholetown.

children.label: b
children.prompt: How far is Keith from Wholetown at 1:40 p.m.?

answer.worked: At 40 minutes after departure, read Keith’s graph vertically from the time axis and then across to the distance axis: approximately 65 km.

children.label: c
children.prompt: At what time does Jonathon pass Keith?

answer.worked: The graphs intersect at 60 minutes, when both are 60 km from Wholetown. This is one hour after 1 p.m., so Jonathon passes Keith at 2 p.m.

children.label: d
children.prompt: For how long does Keith stop?

answer.worked: Keith’s graph is horizontal from 45 to 70 minutes, so his stop lasts $70-45=25$ minutes.

children.label: e
children.prompt: What is Jonathon’s average speed for the journey?

answer.worked: $$\begin{align*}\text{Time taken}&=\frac{100}{60}\text{ h}=\frac53\text{ h}\\\text{Average speed}&=\frac{\text{distance travelled}}{\text{time taken}}\\\text{Average speed}&=\frac{100}{5/3}=60\text{ km/h}\end{align*}$$

children.label: f
children.prompt: What is Keith’s average speed for:

answer.worked: $$\begin{align*}\text{Distance travelled}&=100-60=40\text{ km}\\\text{Time taken}&=\frac{45}{60}\text{ h}=\frac34\text{ h}\\\text{Average speed}&=\frac{40}{3/4}=\frac{160}{3}=53\frac13\text{ km/h}\end{align*}$$
$$\begin{align*}\text{Distance travelled}&=60-0=60\text{ km}\\\text{Time taken}&=\frac{30}{60}\text{ h}=\frac12\text{ h}\\\text{Average speed}&=\frac{60}{1/2}=120\text{ km/h}\end{align*}$$

children.label: iii
children.prompt: the whole journey (excluding his rest time)?

answer.short:
80 km/h

Divide the total distance by the travelling time, excluding the stop.
answer.worked: $$\begin{align*}\text{Total distance}&=40+60=100\text{ km}\\\text{Travelling time}&=45+30=75\text{ min}\\\text{Travelling time}&=\frac{75}{60}\text{ h}=\frac54\text{ h}\\\text{Average speed}&=\frac{100}{5/4}=80\text{ km/h}\end{align*}$$
